title: autotune-cost-opt-defaults-batching-caching-quant-uecon-tooling
author: Aisha Patel
description: Implements autotuning defaults and tooling to optimize per-token unit economics by adjusting batching, prefix/KV caching defaults, and quantization profiles. Motivation: teams repeatedly tune batching and quantization manually leading to inconsistent unit cost and latency regressions; we want a conservative default autotuner that improves typical latency/cost for chat and generation workloads while surfacing expected cost delta to customers. This PR adds: 1) a runtime autotune config module (opt/autotune) that suggests default batch_size and max_latency targets per model-class and tenant tier; 2) conservative prefix/KV caching defaults and heuristics to enable prefix reuse for chat sessions where applicable; 3) quantization profile registry and heuristics to recommend int8/int4 profiles based on model family and accuracy guardrails; 4) unit-econ tooling in tooling/uecon to simulate cost/latency tradeoffs and produce per-route recommendations; 5) dashboard metrics and an API endpoint (/v1/autotune/suggestions) for devs to preview suggested changes before applying. The description below summarizes commits, changed areas, CI, reviews, and merge outcome.
